operationScope: Ordinary production loaded-cloud distance RPC: fresh query snapshot, physical GPU dispatch/readback, streaming exact CPU workers, ordered statistics, f32 export, asynchronous release submission and result transfer. Parsing, pool/device/reference initialization and query-copy diagnostics excluded.
note: Both controls run in the same compiled WASM and cached production worker pool. Both copy settings are explicit; a separate untimed request records and checks the application default. Pool capacity is capped in a measurement-only worker wrapper before production module import. Query release uses normal asynchronous submission, not shared-experiment acknowledgements. CPU/GPU clocks, host activity, GC and power are uncontrolled. Host GPU wait is not shader execution time. Real inputs are unchanged point subsets, not independent surveys or SLAM ground truth. No adapter identity is collected.
